exec.command: while true; do aws sqs receive-message --queue-url "$ORDERS_QUEUE_URL" --wait-time-seconds 20 --max-number-of-messages 10 --output json | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{for(const m of (JSON.parse(s||"{}").Messages||[]))console.log(m.Body.replace(/\s+/g," "))})'; done
